## Personality

Thomas Lynde is a meek man who lives quietly and unobtrusively. He lacks will power to exert, passing through life with little presence.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P13](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0013), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000)_

## History

Thomas Lynde spent his life lacking willpower, being ruled by his mother until he married [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who continued to exert authority over him. He later passed away, an event that led [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to invite the widowed [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) could attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).

_Sources: [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P13](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0013), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P24](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0024), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034)_

## Relationships

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/rachel-lynde--thomas-lynde.md)

Thomas is the husband of [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md). The couple resides in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) until Thomas passes away, an event that prompts [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to invite the widowed [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) can pursue her college education.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), +12 more_
